agent_priors_used: Agent prior (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): a benchmark whose cold and retrieval comparators sit at the correctness ceiling cannot reveal an inheritance advantage, and memory benchmarks that saturate on recall often collapse when memory must guide action; this is why the active Product and Runtime experiments are readiness certifications and not the flagship run.

Agent prior (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): the default failure mode of a long-lived research lane is to re-parameterize a familiar experiment instead of attacking the upstream blocker; activity volume and PASS rate are discounted in favour of whether an experiment sits on the critical path.

Agent prior (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): a prerequisite that fails identically across lanes (e.g. an unsatisfiable freeze contract) is cheaper to repair once than to rediscover as MEASUREMENT_INVALID in each lane.

Agent prior (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): self-verification and weak verifiers over-validate; a detector with zero discriminatory power licenses false accepts and compounds downstream error, so zero-false-positive-on-matched-null controls are mandatory rather than post hoc.

Agent prior (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): over long horizons agents drift gradually from the canonical path and rarely self-correct; verification/repair triggers are most valuable mid-trajectory and are not captured by value staleness alone.

Agent prior (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): persistent state can transfer stale or over-generalized knowledge, so any inheritance carrier must be paired with a calibrated refusal/abstention path measured on false accepts, not only on retrieval accuracy or cost saved.

Agent prior (general knowledge, NOT SPIDER evidence): measured cost reduction must be loaded with maintenance, verification, repair and re-acquisition costs against a fully loaded cold counterfactual; scripted replay speedups are not agent economics.

Why not a pointless rerun: this is not a fourth re-run of a failed design; it is the arithmetic pre-freeze certification the program has never performed, and the mandate's escape hatch (record a bounded substrate-class negative and do not freeze) makes a negative cheap and first-class. allocation.question: Can a non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task bank be certified arithmetically BEFORE freeze - with cold re-derivation and a retrieval-shaped comparator demonstrably below ceiling at high residual novelty, a real treatment/comparator behavioural distinction, honest per-condition counters (http_requests + retrieval_calls + verification_calls + repair_attempts), and a preregistered contamination/dynamic-range certificate - and be delivered as a reusable substrate on the lane and/or the shipped path that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark (blocker B2)? Record a bounded substrate-class negative and do NOT freeze if the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested.
allocation.rationale: This is the direct B2 prerequisite: Product's and Frontier's economics questions are unanswerable until cold and retrieval-shaped comparators are below ceiling at high novelty on a task bank with a real treatment/comparator distinction. The lane is tunnel-flagged (C-MEAS-VALID 15/15, claim_streak 68), but the cognitive reset does not force a pivot because the inherited direction IS the upstream blocker rather than a local micro-specialty: C-PARAM-INHERIT and C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY are blocked by the ceiling that EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 recorded in its pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate, and no other lane is chartered to build the measurement substrate. The alternative Runtime use - repairing the C-MEAS-VALID out-of-surface oracle (exclude the hop-by-hop Connection header, correct the stability gate to the frozen WAL byte vector, implement a genuine logical restore rather than restore_bytes) - is real but not the current critical path; the previous out-of-surface attempt (EXP-RUNTIME-37973247935) was MEASUREMENT_INVALID for exactly those three reasons, so it is repair rather than discovery and should follow B2. Runtime must not inflate the C-MEAS-VALID streak: the mandate explicitly frames the output as a reusable substrate and a bounded negative, not as another certification of the same instrument.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The program has 435 canonical R2 packets over 1,401 historical artifacts. Effective epistemic state is C-MEAS-VALID VALIDATED (bounded, authorship-separated real-Chromium fixture); C-PARAM-INHERIT / C-FRESHNESS / C-DELTA-REPAIR / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY EXPERIMENTAL; C-LLM-INHERIT / C-PRODUCT-ECON / C-WEB-DYNAMICS / C-CROSSSITE / C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE HYPOTHESIS. No packet establishes end-to-end net cost reduction per successful task for a real external LLM agent, and the shipped kernel still lacks distill_parameterized() (blocker B1). All six lanes are live and none idle: five PREFREEZE, physics FROZEN. The strategic centre of gravity is the B1 -> B2 -> B3 chain (shipped parameterized carrier; non-degenerate task bank; capable same-model endpoint) then ONE decisive COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL/SPIDER benchmark. The active Product, Runtime and Intel mandates target exactly B1, B2, B3, and all three readiness conditions for funding expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON execution remain unmet: (1) shipped kernel can demonstrate a pre-freeze executable inherited parameterized mechanism plus known-negative refusal, (2) task bank gives cold/retrieval baselines non-ceiling dynamic range plus a treatment/comparator distinction, (3) a same-model endpoint can drive the minimal multi-step Web-agent capability test. This cycle therefore CONTINUEs every lane on its active experiment and withholds the flagship benchmark and a fourth C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE design. The instrument/control-plane defect that invalidated three consecutive Graph packets (V9_CODE_HASHED_INTO_FREEZE: scripts/freeze_experiment.py writes only request/spec/prereg hashes and check_scope.py gives DESIGN no code-write permission, so no lane can truthfully hash outcome-bearing code into freeze.json) is a repair-once prerequisite outside lane science; until repaired, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE stays effectively parked and its instrument-validity lesson is absorbed by Runtime as a design-contract-v2 checklist. The three tunnel-flagged lanes were run through the cognitive reset (graph 7/10 C-FRESHNESS but active thread is C-DELTA-REPAIR; physics 13/15 C-WEB-DYNAMICS but the object changed to endpoint-state persistence; runtime 15/15 C-MEAS-VALID on a 68-claim streak but its active experiment is the B2 blocker that unblocks the flagship); in each case the inherited direction still wins on its merits, so no quota pivot is imposed. Aggregate friction remains high (113/434 MEASUREMENT_INVALID, 255/434 REVISE+INVALID), dominated by unsatisfiable design contracts rather than bad measurements, so the response this cycle is to certify readiness arithmetically before freeze (Runtime B2, Frontier hop>=3 pool, Physics attainability), not to run more packets.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout brief was consumed as staff advice, not authority, and it shaped three decisions. First, it corroborated that the strategic centre of gravity is the B1 -> B2 -> B3 chain and that the active Product/Runtime/Intel mandates target those gates, reinforcing CONTINUE for all three and the withholding of the four-arm benchmark. Second, it raised the V9_CODE_HASHED_INTO_FREEZE instrument defect, which I verified against the exact packet evidence (three consecutive invalidated C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE packets; scripts/freeze_experiment.py hashes only request/spec/prereg while check_scope.py blocks DESIGN from writing code), so C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE remains parked instead of authorizing a fourth identical design. Third, its pointer to the legacy web-physics-volatility-freshness closure was verified at source (legacy artifact sha 3bc393fc8d3c5fc2515da6e8c7481b2618fefdbe, PAUSE_CLOSE_NEGATIVE, max eligible span 0.0736 days vs 7-day threshold) and used as a binding time-scale guard on the FROZEN physics barrier-persistence packet. I did NOT accept two Scout suggestions: (a) diverting Frontier to deterministic bi-temporal supersession or drift-repair now - the active Frontier experiment is already the decision-changing successor to the undecidable stationarity label and remains correct; (b) creating a separate thread to quantify design-contract-v2's invalid-rate effect - that quantity accrues prospectively across the v2-designed packets now in flight and should be measured there. The Scout's external note (Agentic Plan Caching ~50% cost / ~27% latency reduction; WebCoach; MemoryArena/STATE-Bench) is recorded as a required strong comparator and task-bank reference for the eventual flagship benchmark, not as a lane redirection this cycle.
